title: Tsang Yung Woo

page_data.en:
386
21/5/16.

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

May 19th 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that the rebels have sent a letter
to General Yang in the name of the National Assembly
advising him to declare independence.
It is reported that a man named Tsang Yung Woo 張永和
arrived from Peking on 18th inst. He has come here
to try to induce Generals Yang and Lu to send a telegram
to Peking advising the President not to retire.
It is said that the generals have decided not
to do so, until they have seen what the officials
of other places will do.
The gunboat "Suh Sz 福字" left the Arsenal for
Nanking this morning with 300 rifles and thirty boxes
of ammunition on board.
Shortly after 5 p.m. last night a party of
Chinese drove in a motor car hired from the
E Tah Garage Hupeh Road to No.14 Rue Chapel Frenchtown
which was yesterday reported as the Headquarters of
Chen Chi Mei 陳其美. They entered the house and shot
dead two of the inmates wounding another. In making
their escape which was rendered difficult owing to
the chauffeur running away, and leaving the car they
appear to have shot and wounded two other persons.
One man was arrested and the chauffeur subsequently
returned to the French Police Station and was detained.
Later on the French Police with the assistance of the
Municipal Police arrested a Chinese named Liou Chi
Yun 劉某云 in a Japanese hotel at No.5 Seward Road.
He is suspected of complicity in the murders and it was
gathered from his answers to a few questions that
he was closely in touch with both Chen Chi Mei and
Sun Yat Sen. It is pretty clear that one of the
dead is Chen Chi Mei. The other is a man whom the
French Police caused to leave the Concession and go
to Japan.

Your Obedient Servant,
William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entered on 22nd May 19.

1916年5月21日。

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部）

1916年5月19日。

先生：
据报，叛乱分子以国会名义致函杨将军，劝其宣布独立。
据报，一名名为张永和（Tsang Yung Woo）的男子于本月18日自北京抵达。他来此试图劝说杨将军和卢将军向北京发电报，劝总统不要辞职。
据说，各位将军已决定暂不这样做，直到他们看清其他地方官员的动向为止。
炮舰“福字”号（Suh Sz）今晨离开兵工厂前往南京，船上载有300支步枪和三十箱弹药。
昨晚5点后不久，一伙中国人乘坐从湖北路伊泰车行（E Tah Garage）租来的汽车，驶至法租界霞飞路14号，该处昨日被报为陈其美（Chen Chi Mei）的总部。他们进入屋内，枪杀两名住户，并击伤另一人。在逃离时，由于司机逃跑并弃车而去，导致逃逸困难，他们似乎又开枪击伤了另外两人。一人被捕，司机随后返回法国巡捕房并被拘留。
此后，法国巡捕在工部局巡捕的协助下，在西华德路5号的一家日本旅馆内逮捕了一名名为刘某某（Liou Chi Yun）的华人。他涉嫌参与谋杀案，从他对几个问题的回答中获悉，他与陈其美和孙中山均有密切联系。显然，死者之一是陈其美。另一人是曾被法国巡捕驱逐出公共租界并前往日本的一名男子。

您顺从的仆人，
威廉·阿姆斯特朗（William Armstrong）
总探长。

警务处总监。

录入于1919年5月22日。

Form 2    34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
S. M. POLICE.
C. I. D.
No. 336
Central Station
20th May 1916

REPORT ON Arrest of a man in connection with the
murder of Chen Chi Mei. 陳其美

Made by D.S.Hemingway    Forwarded by Inspector Vaughan
（印：FILED）

The Chief Detective Inspector
C.I.D.

Sir
I beg to report that at 11 am today French detective
Alfonsi, accompanied by two Chinese detectives and
an interpreter from the French Police, came to the
Central Police Station, and requested assistance to
arrest a man, wanted in connection with the
murder of the late Chen Chi Mei ( 陳其美 )
at 114 Rue Chapsal on 18.5.16.

I accompanied them to a lodging
house No 337 Shanlung Road (Louza district)
where the wanted man was arrested in his room.
He gave his name as Woo Kah Woo ( 吳國華 )
a native of Chingkiang, and described himself as
a shopkeeper in that City. He has been staying in
the lodging house since the 11th April, together with a woman
who is described as his wife.

Upon the room being searched, a packet of
grey lime was found, and also several papers, one of
which was an official document, relating to a Chinese
gold mine. No arms or ammunition were found.

The man was brought to the Central
Police Station, where he was subsequently handed
over to the French Police without a warrant.

关于逮捕一名与陈其美（陳其美）谋杀案有关男子的报告。

由 D.S. Hemingway 撰写    由 Vaughan 督察转呈
（印：归档）

致刑事侦缉处总探长

先生：
谨此报告，今日上午11时，法国侦探阿尔丰西（Alfonsi）在两名中国侦探和一名来自法国巡捕房的翻译陪同下，来到中央巡捕房，请求协助逮捕一名通缉犯，该人涉嫌于1916年5月18日在霞飞路114号参与谋杀已故的陈其美（陳其美）。

我陪同他们前往老闸区山龙路337号的一处寄宿寓所，在该房间内逮捕了这名通缉犯。
他自称吴国华（Woo Kah Woo），镇江人，自称是该市的店主。自4月11日以来，他一直与该寓所的一名女子同住，该女子被称为其妻子。

在对房间进行搜查时，发现了一包灰色石灰，以及几份文件，其中一份是关于中国金矿的官方文件。未发现武器或弹药。

该男子被带至中央巡捕房，随后在无逮捕令的情况下被移交给法国巡捕。

REGISTRY.
No. 2262
Date 10/2/16 Station.
Central Police
10th February 1916
REPORT ON Chen Chi Mei.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster Forwarded by
Sir
Still another Warrant has been issued for the arrest of
Chen Chi Mei 陳其美 this time for complicity with others in the
murder of the Manager of the Bank of Communications in Frenchtown
on the 8th Ult. Another Warrant against Chen for complicity in
the murder of Admiral Tseng is also in existence, the French Auth-
orities refusing to assist on that occasion, an attitude which
they will no doubt adopt on this occasion also.
Your Obedient Servant
MBrewster.
D.S.I.
Chief Det Insp.
10/2/16

先生：
针对陈其美（陳其美）的逮捕令再次签发，此次是因为他涉嫌与他人合谋，于上月8日在法租界谋杀交通银行经理。另有一份针对陈其美涉嫌参与谋杀曾提督（Admiral Tseng）的逮捕令也存在，当时法国当局拒绝提供协助，无疑此次他们也会采取同样的态度。

M. Brewster。

Form 2
Shanghai Municipal Police.
SSMPOLICE
C. I. D.
REGISTRY
No. 3365
Central Date: ............Stations....
December 13th, 1915.

REPORT ON supposed departure of Chen Chi Kai from Shanghai.

Made by D.S.I.Burnside. Forwarded by .........

Sir,
I beg to report that at 5.40pm 12th inst: Mr Yang, secretary to the Mixed Court Magistrate, telephoned me stating that he was in receipt of a communication from the Bureau of Foreign Affairs to the effect that Chen Chi Kai would leave Shanghai by a Japanese boat leaving that evening for Japan, that the Chinese Government at Peking would pay a reward of $100.000 for the arrest.

Enquiries were immediately made at the Custom House & it was learnt that no boats would be leaving for Japan that evening, that amongst the Japanese boats already left that day were the Takaosan Maru, Kaiko Maru, Pailing Maru, Isshin Maru, Kamo Maru, & Niitaka Maru,

From enquiries made at the shipping offices, it is learnt from the Osaka Shosen Kaisha that a Chinese took passage by their boat, the Niitaka Maru, for Tsingtap but they could not say who or what he was, not having seen him. The other Company's state that no Chinese took passage by their boats.

Your obedient servant,

J. Burnside.
Det: Sub Insp.

Chief Detective Inspector.

1915年12月13日。

关于陈其凯（Chen Chi Kai）疑似离开上海的报告。

由 D.S.I. Burnside 撰写。由 ......... 转呈

先生：
谨此报告，本月12日下午5时40分，混合法庭书记官杨先生致电给我，称他收到外事局的一份来函，大意是陈其凯将搭乘当晚前往日本的日本轮船离开上海，北京中国政府将悬赏100,000美元用于逮捕此人。

随即向海关查询，获悉当晚没有轮船前往日本，当天已离港的日本轮船包括高砂丸（Takaosan Maru）、海光丸（Kaiko Maru）、北岭丸（Pailing Maru）、一心丸（Isshin Maru）、加茂丸（Kamo Maru）和新高丸（Niitaka Maru）。

经向各轮船公司查询，从大阪商船株式会社（Osaka Shosen Kaisha）获悉，一名中国人乘坐其所属的新高丸前往青岛，但他们因未见到该人，无法说明其身份或具体情况。其他公司均表示没有中国人乘坐其轮船。

您顺从的仆人，

J. Burnside。
侦探副督察。

总探长。
